Remark
[Shrinking spherical space forms in dimension three] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0256 1. Remark 8.21\group dilations-of-finite-time-singularities

Any Type I singularity starting from a compact $3$-manifold of positive Ricci curvature yields a Type I limit that is a shrinking spherical space form.
